reviewNote: All100 actual game/reference pairs reviewed with explicit source/visual gaps;19 current water retakes plus81 unchanged original image bytes. Capture coverage complete; real-world parity remains incomplete.

review.status: All100 actual game/reference pairs reviewed with explicit source/visual gaps;19 current water retakes plus81 unchanged original image bytes. Capture coverage complete; real-world parity remains incomplete.
review.comparisonMethod: Private georeferenced Esri crop at each exact250m north-up ground square; actual source/image/sheet hashes retained per frame. Roof parallax and unknown reference acquisition are not source measurements. Reference imagery is not published.
